description: Exact return shape of SigData.genGear(n) in assets/engine.js. Every field is always present on archive records (JAH-GEAR-%07d). All archive equipment is Signature-original (status SIGNATURE ORIGINAL; see assets/app.js recStatus).

desc.description: GEAR base[2] description + ' ' + the patch guide string.

id.description: Permanent ID. Never reused. Reproducible seed is n.

n.description: Deterministic seed. genGear uses rngFrom('gearrec:' + n).

name.description: GEAR base[1], plus ' Mk <rev>' for revision > 1 where rev = floor(n / 25) + 1.

patch.description: Generated patch guide, e.g. 'Patch guide: <name> -> Patch-16 top row -> PA-1 preamp -> IO-8 input 3. Set gain so peaks hit -12 dB.' See the patch schema + RECORD-STANDARD.md 'real patch guides' section for the honesty classification.

title: Signature Music Studio — Equipment record
